finalText:
All 12 files check out clean, no syntax errors. No test setup in this repo to run.

Migration's done. I updated 12 files across accounts, billing, catalog, orders, support, and analytics, switching every `db.query(sql, params)` call to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. I left one file alone: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so it still calls `db.query`. There's also a `cache.query` call in `session.js` — that's a different module, not part of this migration, so I left it too.
